capabilities.target: configured config, public keys, private channel keys, packages, credential, and state paths
capabilities.justification: Loads bounded configuration and composes the keyring, owner-only channel-key provisioning, package verification, credential, and durable registry adapters.

capabilities.target: host names declared by a verified agent manifest's net:dns capabilities

capabilities.target: HTTPS host:port pairs declared by a verified agent manifest's net:connect capabilities
capabilities.justification: Executes the D18V net.fetch operation on an agent's behalf, injecting a leased credential only for destinations the sealed secret record allows.
Composes verified shell-free host process supervision.
Receives cooperative service shutdown and reaps owned children during teardown.
Schedules reconciliation and validates host heartbeat age.

capabilities.target: bounded reconciliation, shutdown, and process-control waits
